integrity: The mixed generating identity is derived directly from the Prüfer bijection. The factorial covariance formula follows by exact multinomial factorial moments, with the first-order zero and all higher-order signs determined algebraically. An exhaustive checker independently replays the identities through n=8.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas use the uniform labeled Cayley-tree law and its iid uniform Prüfer code.
The result concerns one distinguished vertex against the global leaf count and does not assert independence.
Equivalent formulas may be implicit in classical occupancy literature because Prüfer codes turn the problem into a balls-in-boxes calculation.
title: Cayley-tree degree is leaf-orthogonal only at first order
